why: [R-BRIDGE-01] with the ratchet of [R-ENF-02]. Every study directory on disk when the bridge standard was adopted (02-Sep-2026) other than PHDC and TMGH carries no bridge record; each is allowed to fail while it waits its turn in the rebuild queue. The build breaks on a NEW study with no entry either way, or on a listed study whose record has appeared and is wrong. This list may only ever get SHORTER (--prune).
